  4. 04 Everything you need to ship, nothing you don’t <section>
    Block: Feature bento
    Everything you need to ship, nothing you don’t 
    <section data-block="feature-bento" class="section" id="features" aria-labelledby="bento-title">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="block-header block-header--center">
          <p class="eyebrow">Features</p>
          <h2 class="block-header__title" id="bento-title">Everything you need to ship, <span class="text-gradient">nothing you don’t</span></h2>
          <p class="block-header__lead">Every block follows W3C standards and MDN best practices, so it drops into any stack.</p>
        </div>
        <ul class="bento" role="list">
          <li class="bento__item bento__item--wide bento__item--feature">
            <span class="block-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2 2 7l10 5 10-5z"/><path d="m2 17 10 5 10-5M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg></span>
            <h3 class="bento__title">Design tokens drive everything</h3>
            <p class="bento__text">Change one brand colour and every button, chart and focus ring follows, with contrast checked in light and dark mode.</p>
            <div class="bento__visual swatch-row" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
          </li>
          <li class="bento__item bento__item--tall">
            <span class="block-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="4.5" r="1.5"/><path d="M5 8.5 12 10l7-1.5M12 10v4.5M12 14.5 9 21M12 14.5l3 6.5"/></svg></span>
            <h3 class="bento__title">Accessible by default</h3>
            <p class="bento__text">Keyboard support, visible focus and screen-reader text are built in, not bolted on.</p>
            <div class="bento__visual stack stack--xs">
              <div class="meter"><span>Lighthouse accessibility: 98</span><span class="meter__track" aria-hidden="true"><span class="meter__fill meter__fill--98"></span></span></div>
              <div class="meter"><span>Keyboard coverage: 90%</span><span class="meter__track" aria-hidden="true"><span class="meter__fill meter__fill--90"></span></span></div>
              <div class="meter"><span>Contrast pairs passing: 100%</span><span class="meter__track" aria-hidden="true"><span class="meter__fill"></span></span></div>
            </div>
          </li>
          <li class="bento__item">
            <span class="block-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 2 3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9z"/></svg></span>
            <h3 class="bento__title">Zero dependencies</h3>
            <p class="bento__text">Nothing to install, nothing to audit. Pages load in milliseconds.</p>
          </li>
          <li class="bento__item">
            <span class="block-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/></svg></span>
            <h3 class="bento__title">Strict CSP</h3>
            <p class="bento__text">No inline scripts, styles or handlers. XSS-safe rendering everywhere.</p>
          </li>
          <li class="bento__item bento__item--half">
            <span class="block-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m16 18 6-6-6-6M8 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg></span>
            <h3 class="bento__title">Copy, paste, ship</h3>
            <p class="bento__text">Every block is one section of semantic HTML.</p>
            <pre class="bento__visual code-peek" aria-hidden="true"><span class="tok-tag">&lt;section</span> <span class="tok-attr">class</span>="hero"<span class="tok-tag">&gt;</span>
      <span class="tok-tag">&lt;h1&gt;</span>Hello<span class="tok-tag">&lt;/h1&gt;</span>
    <span class="tok-tag">&lt;/section&gt;</span></pre>
          </li>
          <li class="bento__item bento__item--half">
            <span class="block-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M2 12h20M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg></span>
            <h3 class="bento__title">Works in any framework</h3>
            <p class="bento__text">Guides for each stack, and the markup ports one to one.</p>
            <ul class="bento__visual chip-row" role="list">
              <li>React</li><li>Next.js</li><li>Vue</li><li>Svelte</li><li>ASP.NET</li><li>Django</li><li>Laravel</li><li>Rails</li>
            </ul>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

  8. 08 Simple pricing that grows with you <section>
    Block: Pricing
    Simple pricing that grows with you 
    <section data-block="pricing" class="section pricing" id="pricing" aria-labelledby="pricing-title">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="block-header block-header--center">
          <p class="eyebrow">Pricing</p>
          <h2 class="block-header__title" id="pricing-title">Simple pricing that grows with you</h2>
          <p class="block-header__lead">Start free. Upgrade when your team does. Cancel anytime.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="pricing__toggle">
          <fieldset class="fieldset">

          <p class="text-muted">Everything you need to know about the kit. Can’t find an answer?</p>

            <strong>Talk to a person</strong>
            <p class="text-muted text-sm">We reply within one business day.</p>

          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="accordion">
          <details class="accordion__item" name="faq-block" open>
            <summary class="accordion__summary">Do I need Node.js or a build tool? <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
            <div class="accordion__panel">
              <p>No. Serve the folder with any static web server and it works. Node.js is only used by the optional validation scripts.</p>
            </div>
          </details>
          <details class="accordion__item" name="faq-block">
            <summary class="accordion__summary">Which browsers are supported? <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
            <div class="accordion__panel">
              <p>The last two versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop and mobile. Newer features degrade gracefully.</p>
            </div>
          </details>
          <details class="accordion__item" name="faq-block">
            <summary class="accordion__summary">Can I use it in a commercial product? <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
            <div class="accordion__panel">
              <p>Yes. Everything is MIT licensed, including the templates and the page builder output.</p>
            </div>
          </details>
          <details class="accordion__item" name="faq-block">
            <summary class="accordion__summary">Does it work with React, .NET or Django? <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
            <div class="accordion__panel">
              <p>Yes. The markup maps one to one to JSX, Razor and Django templates, and the integration guide covers each stack.</p>
            </div>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>

    <dialog class="dialog drawer" id="theme-panel" aria-labelledby="theme-panel-title" closedby="any">
  <div class="dialog__header">
    <h2 class="dialog__title" id="theme-panel-title">Customize theme</h2>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" commandfor="theme-panel" command="close">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
      <span class="visually-hidden">Close theme panel</span>
    </button>
  </div>
  <form class="dialog__body form" data-theme-customizer>
    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Mode</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="system"><span class="segmented__label">System</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="light"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg> Light</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="dark"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg> Dark</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Brand colour</legend>

        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="indigo"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--indigo"></span> Indigo</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="teal"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--teal"></span> Teal</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="violet"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--violet"></span> Violet</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="rose"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--rose"></span> Rose</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="amber"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--amber"></span> Amber</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="slate"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--slate"></span> Slate</label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-custom-color">Or pick any brand colour</label>
      <p class="field__hint" id="theme-custom-hint">Shades are adjusted automatically to keep text readable in both themes.</p>
      <input class="color-input" id="theme-custom-color" name="custom" type="color" value="#2a4fcf" aria-describedby="theme-custom-hint">
    </div>

    <p class="text-sm text-muted" role="status" data-theme-contrast></p>

      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Density</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="compact"><span class="segmented__label">Compact</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="comfortable"><span class="segmented__label">Comfortable</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Corners</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="sharp"><span class="segmented__label">Sharp</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="round"><span class="segmented__label">Round</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-css-output">CSS for your project</label>
      <textarea class="textarea textarea--code" id="theme-css-output" readonly rows="8" data-theme-output></textarea>

    <div class="form-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm" data-copy data-copy-target="#theme-css-output" hidden><span data-copy-label>Copy CSS</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm btn--ghost" data-theme-reset>Reset to defaults</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
